name: Jenkins
summary: Jenkins is an open source automation server released under the MIT License, so the software costs nothing. A team runs it on its own servers, which means paying for the machines and the admin time. The project lists more than 2,300 community plugins.

facts.text: The license is MIT, held by the Jenkins project contributors, and grants use free of charge.
The project home page lists more than 2,300 community-contributed plugins.
The Pipeline chapter says a Pipeline's code defines the entire build process, with example stages for build, test and deploy.
The Console Output page link shows the full output from a Pipeline run.

hiddenCosts: The team hosts and maintains Jenkins itself, so servers, build agents, upgrades and plugin security work are its own cost.
The jenkins.io pages checked list no commercial support price.
